## 中文版本说明

### Agent 工作台渐进式升级

- 为售前工作台、招投标、公文写作、课题申报、项目协作、论文导师、软件著作和专利生成接入统一 Agent 能力。
- 支持检查当前项目、规划下一步和连续执行，并继续复用原有业务流程与数据，不改变既有功能的使用结果。
- Agent 功能仍受“开发者模式”和“Agent 工作台（内测）”开关控制，关闭后立即生效，无需重启客户端。

### 全新悬浮交互

- 将占用内容区域的横向 Agent 条改为类似辅助触控圆点的悬浮入口，减少对核心操作区的遮挡。
- 支持鼠标悬停显示简要状态、点击展开完整操作面板。
- 新增自由拖动、自动贴边和位置记忆，重新进入页面后可恢复上次悬浮位置。

### 界面与体验优化

- 优化软件著作“源码准备”页面的信息层级、操作区和空状态展示。
- 精简技术方案正文页的过程统计信息，避免调试性质内容占用正文空间。
- 调整设置页：主题支持经典、柔光、暗黑和跟随系统；移除当前无实际选择意义的语言与侧边栏布局选项。
- 统一多个 Agent 场景的紧凑布局、按钮尺寸与响应式表现。

## English Release Notes

### Progressive Agent Workbench Upgrade

- Added a shared Agent foundation to the Presales Workbench, Bidding, Official Documents, Grant Applications, Project Collaboration, Thesis Tutor, Software Copyright, and Patent Generation modules.
- Agents can inspect the current project, plan the next step, and run consecutive steps while reusing the existing workflows and data without changing current feature results.
- Agent features remain gated by Developer Mode and the Agent Workbench beta switch. Turning them off now takes effect immediately without restarting the client.

### New Floating Interaction

- Replaced the space-consuming horizontal Agent banner with a compact assistive-touch-style floating entry point that stays out of the primary workspace.
- Hover to view a brief status and click to open the full Agent action panel.
- Added free dragging, automatic edge snapping, and position memory across page visits.

### UI and Experience Improvements

- Improved the information hierarchy, action layout, and empty states of the Software Copyright source-preparation page.
- Simplified process statistics on the Technical Plan content page so diagnostic details no longer occupy the writing area.
- Updated Settings with Classic, Aurora, Dark, and Follow System themes, while removing language and sidebar-layout options that had no meaningful alternatives.
- Standardized compact Agent layouts, button sizing, and responsive behavior across supported modules.
